race.comment: SAVASTEEL (3) is yet to break through in seven runs but has been thereabouts. Last start was fifth placing over 1000m at Sunshine Coast. Will be handy despite the tricky draw and is sure to play a major role. GOODFELLA FINCH (1) raced below his best last time when sixth over 1000m at Dalby, beaten 9 lengths. Draws favourably and is a likely improver with strong top-three prospects. MOONLIGHT ODYSSEY (2) resumes from a spell of three-and-a-half months and is having his first outing under new trainer Kym Afford. Finished fifth at Muswellbrook over 900m at the opening run last time in work. Fitter for a minor placing in a recent Nanango trial and any market confidence must be noted. AKKU (4) won't be far away on her recent figures.
